## Solution
<!-- Schema[IMP/Solution]: 選填（.claude/pm-rules/ticket-body-schema.md） -->
### 安全檢查結果（IMP-005 教訓）

對 27 個 basename 各跑全量 .py/.json 引用檢查，排除 skill 層自身與主層副本本身。命中分類（全部為非 active 引用）：

| 引用來源 | 性質 | 判定 |
|---------|------|------|
| settings.json | 全部以 skill 層路徑登記（grep -v skills 後 0 命中） | 非主層 active |
| hook-registry.json line 109/112 | 僅被 hook-completeness-check.py 讀取做比對，非 runtime dispatch | 文件性，需同步路徑 |
| .claude/hooks/lib/*.py | 純註解說明 | 非呼叫 |
| .claude/lib/hook_logging.py | docstring 來源歷史說明 | 非呼叫 |
| .claude/hooks/acceptance_checkers/*.py | docstring（orchestrator 說明） | 非呼叫 |
| 主層 hook 互引 | 註解（功能合併歷史） | 非呼叫 |
| tests/*.py | 全部以 skill 層路徑（ticket_skill_hooks_path）載入，無一以主層 _hooks_dir 載入 | 載入 skill 版 |

特別驗證：grep 以 spec_from_file/hook_path/exec_module/Path 載入 27 名且排除 skill → 0 命中。結論：27 個全數通過安全檢查，確為死碼。

### 刪除清單（27 個主層死碼副本）

依 W9-004「可刪除清單」逐一刪除：acceptance-gate-hook, agent-ticket-validation-hook, ana-ticket-metadata-validation-hook, creation-acceptance-gate-hook, handoff-auto-resume-stop-hook, handoff-cleanup-hook, handoff-prompt-reminder-hook, handoff-reminder-hook, needs-context-listener-hook, post-ticket-complete-checkpoint-hook, post-ticket-lifecycle-hook, stop-worklog-handoff-sync-check-hook, ticket-creation-validation-hook, ticket-file-access-guard-hook, ticket-frontmatter-validator-hook, ticket-id-validator-hook, ticket-path-guard-hook, ticket-quality-gate-hook, ticket-reinstall-hook, ticket-skill-sync-check-hook, worktree-auto-commit-hook, worktree-base-distance-check-hook, worktree-branch-check-hook, worktree-commit-before-dispatch-hook, worktree-merge-reminder-hook, worktree-zombie-cleanup-hook, wrap-decision-tripwire-hook（全為 .py）。

### hook-registry.json 同步

line 109：.claude/hooks/creation-acceptance-gate-hook.py → .claude/skills/ticket/hooks/creation-acceptance-gate-hook.py
line 112：.claude/hooks/handoff-prompt-reminder-hook.py → .claude/skills/ticket/hooks/handoff-prompt-reminder-hook.py
對齊 settings.json 既有 skill 層登記（line 613/627）。
